title: PowerFresh Steam Mop - not so great
text:
PowerFresh Steam Mop - not so great. Over the past several years, I have purchased several steam mops: Shark Pocket, Haan, Euroflex Monster and now this Bissell Power Fresh Steam Mop (purchased locally). I wanted a mop to put out nice hot steam that is hot enough to cut through stuff, swivel and ALSO fit under my kitchen cabinets.

This Power Fresh Steam Mop by Bissell DOES have a low head to fit under cabinets and it does swivel. Compared to the Euroflex Monster (steam temp is 212F per product specs), this Steam Fresh doesn't come close. Even on the hottest setting, the steam is less hot and abundant. (The Monster has steam from both the bottom and the front). Also, using the medium and highest settings left my floor SOGGY.

I was quite interested in the fresh scent disks for leaving that clean scent (yes, I know -- don't have to smell a fragrance to be clean). The scent to me was very minimal.

Pads: They are about the thinnish quality of the Shark and get soggy quickly. My floors aren't that dirty, but I have to use two or three (only 2 included) to do a medium-sized kitchen floor.
Handle: Sturdy, but they unit tips over easily.
Tank: Very small, but easy to refill.
Steam: Not very hot (compared to the Euroflex at 212F)- hold the mop over an area for 20 seconds to sanitize. Yikes .. takes ages to "santize" an entire floor.
Head Maneverability: Nice and low height.
Fresh Scent Disks: Barely noticeable (but might be my nose).

Bottom line: The steam only comes from one area on the bottom (as opposed to several jets). The clugging/chugging noise (normal, per instructions) is a bit annoying. I DO like the swivel head, and the fresh scent (such as it is). The low height makes it nice for cleaning under cabinets. The steam isn't that hot and one has to leave the mop over an area for 20 seconds to sanitize leaves much to be desired.

For Sanitizing and cleaning a large area, I'LL STICK TO MY EUROFLEX MONSTER. This will work for smaller areas.
